source_title: Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary: The Crystal Edition Confirmed for January 2027 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
In 2027, the Final Fantasy series will celebrate its 40th anniversary, and Square Enix has already confirmed a new release set to drop in January. Since 1987, Final Fantasy has been a pioneer of the JRPG genre, establishing gameplay and features that have become the gold standard today. The music of Final Fantasy has also become iconic among gaming soundtracks, which Square Enix plans to showcase in this upcoming anniversary release.
Final Fantasy has already had a major 2026, even outside of its impending 40th anniversary celebrations. The recent launch of Final Fantasy Resonance saw iconic characters from across the franchise, such as FF10 's Tidus and FF13 's Lightning , finally return to Final Fantasy . Even more Final Fantasy content is on the way in the coming year, with the release of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation and FF14: Evercold launching in 2027.
Square Enix Announces Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary: The Crystal Edition Soundtrack
To celebrate 40 years of Final Fantasy, Square Enix is releasing Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary: The Crystal Edition . This release is a vinyl record composed of one iconic song that represents each mainline Final Fantasy game , for a total of 16 tracks. The soundtrack is already available for pre-order in Japan for 8,800 yen, with a release date of January 6, 2027. Pages for North American and European releases of the soundtrack are also up, but pre-orders are not yet available in these regions.
Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary: The Crystal Edition Track List
Battle at the Big Bridge — Final Fantasy 5
Searching for Friends — Final Fantasy 6
The Dalmasca Estersand — Final Fantasy 12
Torn from the Heavens — Final Fantasy 14
Somnus (Instrumental Version) — Final Fantasy 15
Each song included on this anniversary album is meant to capture the spirit of the entry it represents and take listeners on a musical odyssey through the franchise. Classic songs like "One-Winged Angel", the theme of Final Fantasy 7 's villain Sephiroth , and Final Fantasy 5 's "Battle at the Big Bridge," where players face off against Gilgamesh, are iconic battle themes represented in this release. Other battle themes on this soundtrack include songs like Final Fantasy 8 's "Force Your Way" and Final Fantasy 13 's "Blinded by Light."

Battle themes are an important part of Final Fantasy 's JRPG combat , but they aren't the only tracks notable within the franchise. The more emotional melodies of tracks like Final Fantasy 9 's "You're Not Alone" and Final Fantasy 10 's "To Zanarkand" also make it onto this album. While some Final Fantasy fans might debate whether this is the definitive lineup of music from the series, it's still an excellent collection of tracks.
In addition to Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary: The Crystal Edition, other releases celebrating the franchise are planned for 2027 as well. Square Enix gallery cards featuring Final Fantasy characters are releasing in April 2027, and fans can experience more selection of music from across the Final Fantasy franchise at the Distant Worlds concert tour next year as well.
